## **Canonical Phase 1 Blueprint and Enterprise FastMCP Pattern**

A rigorous audit of Dossier 06 (06\_canonical\_phase\_1\_implementation\_blueprint.md) confirms that the Phase 1 reference architecture achieves **100% upstream parity with zero core engine modification** (git \-C \~/.hermes/hermes-agent status \--porcelain \== "")5. In upstream NousResearch/hermes-agent, agent/prompt\_builder.py (build\_context\_files\_prompt()) executes a mutually exclusive discovery chain for workspace context files (.hermes.md/HERMES.md ![][image25] AGENTS.md hierarchy ![][image25] CLAUDE.md ![][image25] .cursorrules) while independently loading \~/.hermes/SOUL.md from HERMES\_HOME1. By deleting legacy \~/.hermes.md and .hermes/runtime\_hooks/sitecustomize.py, the upstream engine natively ingests \~/.hermes/SOUL.md (Layer 1\) and the hierarchical AGENTS.md chain (Layer 2\) while mounting .hermes/mcp\_openjev.py (Layer 3\) over the standard Model Context Protocol (stdio) configured in \~/.hermes/config.yaml1.

### **Mathematical Certification of BPE Suffix Jitter Neutralization**

In llama-server on Port 8138, autoregressive decoding of a file path ![][image36] under Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and N-gram speculative drafting (--spec-type draft-mtp,ngram-map-k) accepts a drafted token ![][image37] when the draft acceptance condition holds1:  
![][image38]  
When ![][image39] (the legacy GDR14/15 setting), flat logit distributions at snake\_case delimiter boundaries (/, \_, .) allowed low-probability draft tokens (\_py, py, .p, or Cyrillic PLE neighbors) to enter the verification pass and pollute the 4,096-token SWA window3. The Phase 1 blueprint permanently eliminates this failure mode through a coupled two-tier defense spanning the 60% infrastructure and 30% orchestration layers3. At the **Decoding Gate (60% Infrastructure)**, setting \--spec-draft-p-min 0.72 truncates the speculative draft tree whenever the draft model's marginal confidence drops below ![][image40], forcing standard exact target-model decoding across high-entropy filename transitions1. Simultaneously, at the **Deterministic Schema Gate (30% Orchestration)**, every FastMCP file tool inherits from SafePathModel in Pydantic v2 (pydantic \>= 2.9.0, ConfigDict(extra="forbid"))5. Before any tool body executes, @field\_validator("path", mode="before") applies a sequence of idempotent regular expression projections ![][image41] that strip non-ASCII PLE collisions, collapse duplicated BPE suffixes (r'(\\.py)\[\_a-zA-Z0-9\]\+$'\rightarrow '.py'),repairunderscoreorwhitespacedelimiterdrops(r'{[}_{]}+py$' \\to \\text{'.py'}), restore missing dots on test modules (r'(test\_\[a-zA-Z0-9\_\]+?)(?\<\!\\.)py\$' \\to \\text{'\\1.py'}), and expand truncated extensions (r'\\.p\$' \\to \\text{'.py'})3.
